title: User Interface Basics - Quiz
description: Test your knowledge of PEGA UI components, harnesses, and responsive design

questions.question: What is a harness in PEGA UI architecture?
options: A top-level container that defines the overall page structure
questions.explanation: A harness is a top-level container that defines the overall structure and layout of a page or screen in PEGA applications.

questions.question: Which UI component is used to group related fields together?
questions.explanation: Sections are used to group related fields and controls together, providing logical organization and reusability in PEGA UI design.

questions.question: PEGA supports responsive design for mobile devices.
questions.explanation: True. PEGA provides built-in responsive design capabilities that automatically adapt the UI for different screen sizes and devices.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a layout in PEGA UI?
options: To define the arrangement of sections and controls
questions.explanation: Layouts define how sections and controls are arranged on the screen, providing structure and visual organization to the user interface.

questions.question: You need to create a form that displays customer information, order details, and payment options in separate organized groups. Which PEGA UI approach would be most appropriate?
options: Put everything in one large section
Create separate sections for each group within a layout
Create separate harnesses for each group
questions.explanation: Creating separate sections for each logical group (customer info, order details, payment) within a layout provides the best organization, reusability, and maintainability.

questions.question: Which control type would you use for a dropdown list of countries?
questions.explanation: A Dropdown control is specifically designed for presenting a list of options where users can select one value, making it perfect for country selection.

questions.question: PEGA UI components can be styled using custom CSS.
questions.explanation: True. PEGA allows custom CSS styling to modify the appearance of UI components while maintaining responsive behavior and accessibility standards.

questions.question: What is the main advantage of using sections in PEGA UI design?
options: They provide reusability across different harnesses
questions.explanation: Sections provide reusability - once created, they can be used across multiple harnesses and layouts, promoting consistency and reducing development time.

questions.question: A mobile user is accessing your PEGA application on a smartphone. What feature ensures the interface adapts properly?
questions.explanation: PEGA's built-in responsive design automatically adapts the interface based on screen size and device capabilities, ensuring optimal user experience across devices.

questions.question: Which principle is most important when designing PEGA user interfaces?
options: Use as many colors as possible
Focus on user experience and task efficiency
Include all possible features on one screen
questions.explanation: Focusing on user experience and task efficiency is crucial - interfaces should be intuitive, help users complete tasks quickly, and reduce cognitive load.
